records.title: Wrapped Bitcoin launches on Ethereum
records.summary: WBTC launched as an ERC-20 token fully backed by Bitcoin held by custodians.
records.significance: WBTC brought Bitcoin liquidity into Ethereum and later became major DeFi collateral.

records.title: QuadrigaCX collapses
records.summary: QuadrigaCX shut down after founder Gerald Cotten's reported death and entered court proceedings. Ontario's later review concluded the exchange owed clients roughly C$215 million and that the shortfall resulted largely from fraud and mismanagement rather than merely inaccessible cold-wallet keys.
records.significance: Quadriga became one of crypto's defining founder-control, custody and exchange-fraud disasters.

records.title: Binance DEX launches on Binance Chain
records.summary: Binance DEX launched as BNB migrated to the newly live Binance Chain.
records.significance: The launch expanded Binance from a centralized exchange into its own blockchain and on-chain market ecosystem.

records.title: New York Attorney General targets Bitfinex/Tether reserve relationship
records.summary: The NYAG obtained a court order in an investigation alleging that Bitfinex and Tether used transactions involving Tether reserves to address an apparent $850 million shortfall.
records.significance: The case became a major turning point in scrutiny of Tether reserves and the relationship between Tether and Bitfinex.

sources.title: NY Attorney General — Bitfinex/Tether court order

records.title: Binance loses 7,000 BTC in hot-wallet attack
records.summary: Attackers withdrew 7,000 BTC after obtaining API keys, 2FA codes and other information through multiple attack methods.
records.significance: It was Binance's defining security incident and a major test of its SAFU user-protection reserve.

records.title: Cryptopia enters liquidation after hack
records.summary: New Zealand exchange Cryptopia was placed into liquidation after a January security breach severely damaged the business.
records.significance: The liquidation became an important legal test for whether cryptocurrency held by an exchange is property held for customers.

records.title: Chainlink mainnet launches
records.summary: Chainlink launched its decentralized oracle network on Ethereum mainnet.
records.significance: It became core infrastructure for bringing external data into DeFi and smart-contract applications.

records.title: FTX exchange launches
records.summary: FTX launched in or around May 2019 as a cryptocurrency derivatives exchange associated with Alameda Research.
records.significance: FTX grew into one of the world's largest exchanges before its catastrophic 2022 failure.

records.title: Facebook announces Libra
records.summary: Facebook announced plans for Calibra, a wallet intended to support Libra, a proposed global blockchain-based currency.
records.significance: Libra instantly pushed stablecoins and private digital money into mainstream central-bank, parliamentary and regulatory debate.

records.title: FATF introduces global virtual-asset Travel Rule framework
records.summary: FATF adopted updated standards and guidance applying AML/CFT obligations to virtual asset service providers, including transfer-information requirements.
records.significance: The move exported crypto AML compliance expectations across jurisdictions and reshaped exchange and wallet infrastructure.

sources.title: FATF — Guidance for Virtual Assets and VASPs

records.title: Bakkt launches physically settled Bitcoin futures
records.summary: ICE Futures U.S. began trading Bakkt's daily and monthly physically settled Bitcoin futures.
records.significance: Bakkt represented a major institutional attempt to integrate physically delivered Bitcoin futures into traditional market infrastructure.

sources.title: ICE Futures U.S. — Bakkt launch reminder

records.title: SEC blocks Telegram TON token distribution
records.summary: The SEC filed an emergency action and obtained a temporary restraining order against Telegram and TON Issuer over an alleged unregistered $1.7 billion token offering.
records.significance: The case became one of the most important US enforcement actions against a large token financing.

records.title: MakerDAO launches Multi-Collateral Dai
records.summary: MakerDAO launched Multi-Collateral Dai, allowing Dai generation against more than one collateral type and renaming original Single-Collateral Dai to Sai.
records.significance: The transition turned Maker into a broader DeFi credit platform and prepared Dai for much larger adoption.

records.title: Monero activates RandomX proof of work
records.significance: RandomX aimed to keep Monero mining accessible to general-purpose CPUs and reduce the advantage of specialized ASIC hardware.
